ValidationRule.description: The Student Presented Risk For field must have a value if "Will Enroll" is a selected option in Student's Intention.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Continued Enrollment'), ISPICKVAL( Student_Intention__c , 'Enrolled'), ISBLANK( TEXT( Student_Presented_Risk_for__c ) ), RecordTypeId = '012d00000021xGK' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Student Presented Risk For is required when selecting 'Will Enroll" from Student Intention
